description: Splunk platform health, APM, synthetic monitoring, and log aggregation — indexer queues, search performance, and forwarder health.
name: Observability & Monitoring Stack
quickFacts: Use the Monitoring Console (MC) built into Splunk and supplement with _internal index searches.

useCases.title: Indexer Queue Fill Ratio
useCases.value: Backed-up indexing queues cause data loss or delay. Detection enables immediate investigation of ingestion bottlenecks.

useCases.title: Search Concurrency Monitoring
useCases.value: Exceeding search concurrency limits causes search skipping and degraded user experience. Monitoring guides capacity decisions.

useCases.title: Forwarder Connectivity
useCases.value: Silent forwarder failures mean data gaps that may not be noticed until an investigation fails. Detection ensures data completeness.

useCases.title: License Usage Trending
useCases.value: License overages cause enforcement (search blocking). Trending enables proactive management and capacity planning.

useCases.title: Skipped Search Detection
useCases.value: Skipped searches mean scheduled reports, alerts, and data enrichments aren't running. This creates blind spots in monitoring and compliance.

useCases.title: Index Size Trending
useCases.value: Index size growth affects storage costs and search performance. Trending enables proactive storage planning.

useCases.title: KV Store Health
useCases.value: KV Store failures break lookups, app functionality, and ES correlation. Health monitoring prevents cascading application issues.

useCases.title: Deployment Server Status
useCases.value: Deployment server issues prevent app/config distribution to forwarders, leaving them with stale or incorrect configurations.

useCases.title: Data Ingestion Latency
useCases.value: High indexing latency (difference between event time and index time) means stale data for searches. Detection enables root cause analysis.

useCases.title: Search Head Cluster Status
useCases.value: SHC member failures affect user access and search capacity. Captain election issues can cause complete SHC outage.

useCases.title: Indexer Cluster Bucket Replication
useCases.value: Under-replicated buckets mean data is at risk of loss. Monitoring ensures the replication factor is maintained.

useCases.title: HEC Endpoint Health
useCases.value: HEC is a primary data ingestion path. Failures silently drop data from applications, containers, and cloud services.

useCases.title: Sourcetype Breakdown Trending
useCases.value: Understanding data volume per sourcetype enables cost optimization, retention tuning, and unexpected growth detection.

useCases.title: Long-Running Search Detection
useCases.value: Long-running searches consume shared resources and may indicate poorly written SPL or excessive time ranges.

useCases.title: Splunk Certificate Expiration
useCases.value: Expired Splunk internal certificates break inter-component communication (forwarder→indexer, SHC replication, etc.).

useCases.title: Parsing Queue Health (_internal)
useCases.value: A saturated parsing queue delays ingestion and increases `_indextime` lag. Tracking fill ratio and blocked state isolates pipeline bottlenecks before data loss.

useCases.title: Merging Queue Health (_internal)
useCases.value: Merging queue backlog delays structured indexing and can block hot buckets. Monitoring prevents silent pipeline stall on heavy merge workloads.

useCases.title: Typing Queue Health (_internal)
useCases.value: The typing queue applies rules to parsed events; backlog here delays field extraction and routing to indexes.

useCases.title: TCP Output Connection Failures (_internal)
useCases.value: Forwarders and intermediate tiers rely on TCP out to indexers. Connection failures mean data is queued or dropped at the source.

useCases.title: Modular Input Errors (_internal)
useCases.value: Scripted and modular inputs drive critical ingestion; errors stop or corrupt data collection without obvious UI failure.

useCases.title: Data Model Acceleration Status (_internal)
useCases.value: Failed or lagging accelerations break pivot searches, ES views, and app dashboards that depend on `tstats`.

useCases.title: Summary Indexing Failures (_internal)
useCases.value: Summary index population jobs feed exec and compliance reports; silent failures skew metrics and dashboards.

useCases.title: Indexer Disk Space Utilization (_internal)
useCases.value: Full indexer volumes stop writes and break replication; proactive disk monitoring avoids cascading cluster failure.

useCases.title: SmartStore Cache Hit/Miss Ratio (_internal)
useCases.value: Low cache hit rates increase S3/API latency and search cost. Trending hit/miss guides cache sizing and bucket locality.

useCases.title: Cluster Bundle Push Failures (_internal)
useCases.value: Failed bundle distribution leaves indexers with stale `indexes.conf`, apps, or peer configs, causing search/replication skew.

useCases.title: splunkd Unexpected Restart Detection (_internal)
useCases.value: Unplanned `splunkd` restarts interrupt searches, replication, and ingestion. Correlating restarts speeds root cause (OOM, crash, admin).

useCases.title: Splunk Web UI Errors (_internal)
useCases.value: Web UI 5xx/timeout errors block analysts during incidents. Tracking errors isolates SHC vs load balancer vs app issues.

useCases.title: SHC Configuration Replication Lag (_internal)
useCases.value: Lagging conf replication causes inconsistent searches and failed lookups across members.

useCases.title: Ingest Actions Pipeline Status (_internal)
useCases.value: Ingest actions (routing, filtering, streaming) failures drop or misroute security and operational data.

useCases.title: Timestamp Parsing Accuracy (_internal)
useCases.value: Mis-parsed timestamps break RT searches, compliance, and `_indextime` lag metrics.

useCases.title: Workload Management Pool Saturation (_internal)
useCases.value: WLM pools prevent search starvation; saturation delays critical searches and alerts.

useCases.title: Search Scheduler Fill Ratio (_internal)
useCases.value: Scheduler at capacity skips searches—blind spots for alerts and summaries.

useCases.title: Knowledge Bundle Size Monitoring (_internal)
useCases.value: Oversized knowledge bundles slow search distribution and SHC replication.

useCases.title: Real-Time Search Resource Consumption (_internal)
useCases.value: Real-time searches reserve cores and memory; runaway RT jobs degrade interactive and scheduled workload.

useCases.title: User Search Activity Audit (_audit)
useCases.value: Auditing who ran which searches supports insider-threat investigations and segregation of duties.

useCases.title: Configuration File Change Tracking (_audit)

useCases.title: Knowledge Object Modification Audit (_audit)

useCases.title: REST API Access Pattern Analysis (_audit)

useCases.title: Role and Capability Change Detection (_audit)
useCases.value: Privilege escalation via new roles/capabilities must be detected in minutes, not days.

useCases.title: Dispatch Directory Size (_introspection)

useCases.title: I/O Wait Bottleneck Detection (_introspection)
useCases.value: High I/O wait on indexers correlates with slow searches, bucket replication, and ingestion lag.

useCases.title: Service Template Adoption and Consistency

useCases.title: Configuration Assistant Recommendations Tracking

useCases.title: Deep Dive Utilization and Performance

useCases.title: Business Service SLA Composite Scoring

useCases.title: Episode MTTR Analysis by Service Tier

useCases.title: ITSI License and Capacity Utilization
